name: Red Dot Jones
premise: A hard-boiled feline detective whose white whale is a laser pointer: two series (owner playing, cosmic conspiracy) in one red dot.

relationships.leverage: Sees the whole room from the floor

sample.joke: The dot was in the kitchen at 6:04. Gone by 6:05. No prints, no scent, no motive — except mockery, which in my experience is motive enough. The Roomba saw nothing. The Roomba always sees nothing. That's how I know it's involved.

self_deception: Believes the city needs him; the city needs the dot put away.

theory_map.element: play vs conspiracy in one dot
theory_map.how_used: Owner's game and cosmic plot coincide; Jones sees only the plot.

theory_map.element: Roomba innocence as proof of guilt
theory_map.how_used: Rule persists past all counter-evidence; sincerity total.
Push to literal consequence: a case built on attitude.
